guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 前往 Sweep 空投页面注册
guide.description: 访问 Sweep 空投页面并使用 Google、X、邮箱或连接的钱包创建一个账户。注册是免费的，只需不到一分钟。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Sign Up on the Sweep Airdrop Page
guide.original_description: Visit the Sweep airdrop page and create an account using Google, X, email, or a connected wallet. Registration is free and takes under a minute.

guide.title: 验证你的账户
guide.description: 从你的仪表盘完成邮箱和 KYC 验证。每个验证级别都会单独奖励 XP，经过验证的账户使你有资格获得最终分配。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Complete email, and KYC verification from your dashboard. Each verification level awards XP on its own, and a verified account keeps you eligible for the final distribution.

guide.title: 完成社交媒体任务
guide.description: 完成活动仪表盘中的社交任务，例如关注 Sweep 的官方渠道。完成的任务会自动获得 XP，但有些奖励需要很短的时间才会出现。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Work through the social tasks in the campaign dashboard, such as following Sweep’s official channels. Finished tasks credit XP automatically, though some rewards take a short while to appear.

guide.title: 每天玩 Sweepbird
guide.description: 打开 Sweepbird 并每天至少玩一轮。一场比赛让你的连胜持续下去，连胜里程碑会解锁小鸟等级徽章，将 XP 永久添加到你的账户中。你还可以通过进入每日刷新的 Sweepbird 排行榜前 100 名来获得额外 XP。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open Sweepbird and play at least one round daily. A single game keeps your streak alive, and streak milestones unlock Bird Tier badges that add XP to your account permanently. You can also earn additional XP by finishing in the Top 100 of the Sweepbird leaderboard, which refreshes daily.

guide.title: 使用你的邀请链接邀请朋友
guide.description: 从你的仪表盘获取邀请链接并分享。邀请是可重复的，因此每个注册并参与的朋友都会不断增加你的总数。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Invite Friends With Your Referral Link
guide.original_description: Grab the referral link from your dashboard and share it. Invites are repeatable, so each friend who signs up and participates keeps adding to your total.

guide.title: 进行符合资格的购买（可选）
guide.description: 符合资格的购买还可奖励 XP。一旦公平启动的第三阶段启动，与购买相关的任务将变得可用。检查活动仪表盘以获取更新和资格详细信息。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Qualifying purchases can also award XP. Purchase-related tasks will become available once Phase 3 of the fairlaunch is active. Check the campaign dashboard for updates and eligibility details.

guide.title: 返回查看新任务和事件
guide.description: Sweep 在空投运行时添加了战役任务和特殊活动。每天快速查看仪表盘可以尽早发现新的 XP 来源。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Check Back for New Tasks and Events
guide.original_description: Sweep adds campaign tasks and special events while the airdrop runs. A quick daily look at the dashboard catches new XP sources early.
